adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly tries to prevent the mismatch described: `GoogleCalendarService.createEvent` now selects the calendar by matching `credentialId` against `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar` (`find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId`) and only falls back to `"primary"` when no matching destination calendar is found. In the main multi-destination path (`EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`), `createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)` is only used when `destination.credentialId` exists, which should make the `find(...credentialId...)` succeed and thus keep the created calendarId aligned with the recorded `externalId`. If the code does fall back to `primary` (no matching destination for that credential), the call site generally does not pass an `externalId` (so `result.externalId` would be `undefined`), meaning the specific claim of recording a non-primary externalCalendarId while creating on primary is not directly supported by what’s shown in this diff.
